decision: Build the minimum validation, audit and recovery path before adding convenience features; freeze one release for evaluation.
credible_alternatives: Build a feature-rich portal first; rejected because it delays testing of the decisive evidence path.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Manual shared-folder baseline versus the prototype under the same synthetic task set, including invalid, duplicate and interrupted submissions.
assumptions_and_risks: Limited task coverage, implementation defects, laboratory environment and absence of real users or adversarial security testing.
conditional_commitment: Build the minimum validation, audit and recovery path before adding convenience features; freeze one release for evaluation.
early_test: Run valid, invalid, duplicate and interrupted submissions against a frozen synthetic set and inspect every retained record.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
